implementation.color: Full luminance graph plus nearest visible endpoint source hues. An incompatible partner neutralizes tint; no scanline-wide hue propagation.
implementation.motion: Seed-domain smoothing plus strict-majority, one-to-one historical carrier claims. Current-frame correspondences are preserved; no blended depth or finished-frame averaging.
implementation.stoppedCamera: Velocity easing reaches exact zero. Static CPU scene captures are reused until pose, version/settings or beacon visibility changes.
implementation.cpuCaptureFinding: Before capture reuse, identical camera matrices sometimes produced RG16 differences of one unit. Completed-frame depth and texture remain stable with capture reuse.
implementation.default: Quiet stereo remains default; Paired color is optional. API temporalStability defaults false; demo checkbox defaults true.

motionFixtures.scope: Controlled moving depth fixtures, not a measured human comfort benefit. Current-depth grayscale pairs exact and stopped frames identical.

colorFixtures.scope: Controlled ring/diamond scenes; RGB can differ between pairs in this mode. No claim of eliminating all perceived echoes.

capturePerformance.scope: One-frame diagnostic readback; not interactive frame timing

limitations: Local normalized correlation on native pixels, sampled on a grid; not a human perceptual model.
Alternate matches include inherent harmonic repetitions; they are candidates, not proof of perceived ghost layers.

fidelity.scope: RGB error versus aligned original render; not a perceptual fusion score

liveReconstruction.signalMode: Complete linear-luminance graph; hues projected to visible eye pairs with nearest-surface ownership.

normalPagePerformance.scope: One stationary normal-page sample; embedded Chromium, no QA readback; not an external Firefox benchmark

humanFeedback.quiet: Fuses, but repeated outlines remain unacceptable.
humanFeedback.sparseSurface: Rejected: doubled artwork and noise rectangles.
humanFeedback.previousPairedColor: Colored depth, but fragile fusion, transparent-looking color artifacts and severe motion static.

limitations: Numerical reconstruction, pair equality and lower frame differences do not prove human fusion or comfort.
Color conflicts can still cause rivalry; neutralization removes some color. Source lighting and full texture are not preserved.
History is path-dependent. Moving depth boundaries and new correspondences can still produce shimmer.
The static CPU capture cache must be invalidated by a future animated host when scene content changes.
Live performance is one stationary 1280x720 embedded Chromium sample, not a new external Firefox benchmark or a hardware guarantee.

Fullscreen and captured-mouse release were not reverified in this revision. Gameplay checks cover key handling and absence of hotkey release calls; prior external mouse confirmation remains human evidence.
